prompt: A breathtaking cinematic anime theatrical key visual movie poster, 3:4 vertical composition. A dynamic low-angle hero shot looking slightly upward at a determined young female anime mechanic with neat dark twin-tail braids. Vintage brass steampunk goggles are resting stylishly on her forehead. She has a serene, resolute expression with expressive luminous eyes. She wears a rugged weathered brown leather tool apron loaded with intricate miniature brass clockwork gears and screwdrivers over an ivory roll-sleeved shirt. Her right hand firmly holds a heavy mechanical brass wrench, while her left hand lifts a glowing vintage steam lantern casting an intense radiant warm amber glow. She stands on an elevated wet industrial iron bridge above a nocturnal Victorian steampunk metropolis. Behind her, colossal tilting brass clockwork gears, copper steam pipes venting plumes of soft white vapor, and intricate Victorian scaffolds form dramatic radial convergence lines. In the foggy deep background, a massive illuminated gothic clock tower face glows faintly through the blue night haze. Stunning chiaroscuro color contrast: radiant warm amber and golden light wrapping around her face and leather apron, juxtaposed with cool moonlight and deep cobalt blue rim lighting carving her silhouette from the right. At the upper section of the poster, the elegant cinematic title 'STEAM & CHIME: 铜钟与蒸汽城' is seamlessly integrated. Masterpiece anime production art, Ufotable and Kyoto Animation visual fidelity, crisp clean linework, semi-realistic tactile leather and polished metal reflections, 8k wallpaper.
